# Cecil & Lou

> Cecil & Lou is a family-owned children's clothing brand in Tyler, Texas, founded in 2011 by Ashley McCain and Blythe McCain. The brand sells classic Southern children's clothing for babies, girls, and boys, with a focus on smocking, embroidery, applique, monograms, heirloom styles, seasonal dressing, and coordinated sibling outfits.

Use this file as a curated index to authoritative public Cecil & Lou resources.

For current price, sale price, stock status, size availability, variants, personalization choices, Pre-Order ship dates, and promotions, use the current individual product page. Ecommerce facts change frequently. Dedicated policy pages control when policy language conflicts with older collection or promotional copy.

This file is for agent orientation and resource discovery. It is not an access-control, ranking, indexing, training-consent, or product-feed mechanism. Crawler access is handled separately, and Cecil & Lou's published LLM License Terms apply to automated use of site content.

## Start Here

- [Homepage](https://www.cecilandlou.com/): Current storefront, featured merchandising, promotions, and major shopping paths.
- [Collections Directory](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections): Broad directory of current Cecil & Lou collections and shopping categories.
- [New Arrivals](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/new-arrivals): Recently added styles; individual products may be in stock or Pre-Order.
- [Our Story](https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/our-story-1): First-party company history, founders Ashley McCain and Blythe McCain, and the brand's 2011 origin.

## Shop by Customer Need

- [Boys](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/boys): Boys clothing including jon jons, bubbles, rompers, sets, pajamas, swim, tops, and outerwear.
- [Girls](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/girls): Girls clothing including dresses, bubbles, sets, pajamas, swim, tops, activewear, and outerwear.
- [Baby](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/baby): Baby gowns, layette, bubbles, rompers, diaper sets, gifts, and heirloom-inspired styles.
- [Accessories](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/accessories): Bows, backpacks, hats, socks, towels, pouches, and other accessories.
- [In Stock](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/in-stock): Products presented as currently available; verify the desired size or variant on the product page.
- [Pre-Order](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/pre-order): Products sold before their expected ship date; each product can have a different shipping window.
- [Monogrammed Clothing](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/monogrammed-clothing): Products that may offer name or monogram personalization; product pages define current options and timing.
- [Matching Sibling Outfits](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/matching-sibling-outfits): Coordinated clothing for babies, brothers, and sisters using shared or complementary prints, fabrics, colors, and motifs.

## Core Seasonal and Occasion Collections

- [Pumpkins](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/pumpkins): Fall and pumpkin-patch styles, including coordinated sibling looks.
- [Thanksgiving](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/thanksgiving): Thanksgiving and harvest-season children's clothing.
- [Fall and Winter](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/fall-winter): Cooler-weather clothing, knitwear, corduroy, outerwear, pajamas, dresses, bubbles, and sets.
- [Christmas](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/christmas): Christmas outfits, dresses, pajamas, sibling coordination, and holiday styles.
- [Heirloom](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/collections-heirloom): Heirloom-inspired smocked and embroidered clothing for portraits, church, baptisms, christenings, and family occasions.
- [Back to School](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/back-to-school): School-themed clothing, first-day looks, picture-day styles, and accessories.
- [Swim](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/swim): Children's swimwear and coordinating family or sibling swim styles.
- [School Spirit](https://www.cecilandlou.com/collections/collections-collegiate): School-spirit and collegiate-themed children's clothing; use current product pages for licensed school availability.

## Policies and Customer Reference

- [Size Guide](https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/size-guide): General child sizing from NB through size 12 plus women's pajama sizing; Cecil & Lou recommends choosing by height first and sizing up when between sizes.
- [Shipping Policy](https://www.cecilandlou.com/policies/shipping-policy): Current processing, Pre-Order, monogram, carrier, and transit guidance.
- [Return Policy](https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/return-policy): Cecil & Lou's all-sales-final policy and instructions for incomplete, incorrect, damaged, or defective orders.
- [FAQs](https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/faqs): Customer questions about ordering, gift notes, checkout, store credit, monograms, and Pre-Orders.
- [Contact](https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/contact): Customer contact form and current company contact information.
- [LLM License Terms](https://www.cecilandlou.com/pages/terms): Cecil & Lou's published terms for use of publicly available website content by LLMs and AI systems.
